defs.def: a number of things that have been placed on top of each other 摞；垛；沓

ex.s: So what to do with all those perfectly-good-but-you're-maybe-a-little-sick-of-them clothes piled on your bedroom floor? ____16____.
ex.t: 一场成功的交换活动取决于衣服的选择、活动的组织，以及显而易见的有多少乐趣。

defs.def: a mass of sth that is high in the middle and wider at the bottom than at the top 堆；成堆的东西

ex.s: This was __50__ than it sounds. __51__ a bit and the cakes pile up.
ex.t: 正如我在第一天晚餐时告诉父母的那样，这一切比我__52__的压力要大一些。

ex.s: Over the weekend， he worked through the piles of handmade cards at his house． One card from a student stood out to him． It read： "Mr． Haze，you are my sunshine．"
ex.t: D．建议一种在我们终身事业中追求卓越的方式。

ex.s: It might seem strange to hoard a bunch of processed, strung-together shells, but what is a pile of dollars?
ex.t: 根据文章，以下哪项是正确的？

defs.def: a lot of sth 大量；许多
the short threads, pieces of wool, etc. that form the soft surface of carpets and some types of cloth such as velvet 绒头；绒毛
a large wooden, metal or stone post that is fixed into the ground and used to support a building, bridge, etc. 桩；桩柱
a large impressive building 宏伟建筑物
to put things one on top of another; to form a pile 堆放；摞起；叠放
to put sth on/into sth; to load sth with sth 放置；装入

ex.s: Then, in 2015, cleaners in an Italian gallery threw away an art piece after mistaking the pile of empty bottles, cigarette ends and pieces of coloured paper for rubbish!
ex.t: 然后，在2015年，意大利一家画廊的清洁工误将一堆空瓶、烟蒂和彩色纸片当作垃圾扔掉了一幅艺术品！

ex.s: As there were no hills in McFarland, their coach, Jim White, made them run up and down large piles of nut shells covered in white plastic sheets.
ex.t: 由于麦克法兰没有山丘，他们的教练吉姆\u00b7怀特让他们在被白色塑料布覆盖的大堆坚果壳上跑上跑下。

ex.s: What was literally a pile of wolves writhed and tumbled in the center of an open flat at the foot of our rimrock.
ex.t: 那简直是一堆狼，在我们岩壁脚下开阔平地的中央翻滚扭打着。

ex.s: We could also say In the very deepest ocean trenches more than 8,000 metres down, the pressure is equal to 50 aeroplanes piled on top of each other.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：在最深的超过8000米的海沟中，压力相当于50架飞机堆叠在一起的重量。

ex.s: Snow covers the streets and is piled up along the sidewalks.
ex.t: 雪覆盖着街道，沿着人行道堆积起来。

defs.def: to go somewhere quickly without order or control 许多人
to make sth increase rapidly 使迅速增加；猛增
to express a feeling in a much stronger way than is necessary 夸张；夸大其词
to give sb more or too much of sth 过度施加；猛增某物
